desc: Faithful port of sad2: extracted flute pitch contour (340 Hz sliding to 235, then an octave drop to ~118 Hz) and its energy envelope, plain robot voice.
Same contour as v1 but breathy and soft: quack buzz halved, pink-noise breath added, slow 4 Hz vibrato, no attack.
v2 transposed down 3 semitones (285 -> 100 Hz), closer to the duck's own register; darker, heavier.
sad2 contour stretched 1.4x in time (a 1.1 s sigh) with a smooth exponential decay instead of the flute's envelope; breathy.
sad2 with the octave step smoothed into one continuous downward glide (346 -> 119 Hz over 80% of the call), flute envelope kept; breathy.
Port of irritated2 at the original height (420-520 Hz growl with a swell near the end), raspy: full quack buzz at 30 Hz, crackle, sharp attack.
irritated2 transposed down 6 semitones (300-370 Hz, in the duck's register), slower 26 Hz rasp, a little more crackle.
Port of frustrated1 at the original height (630 Hz plateau sagging to 460 Hz over 2 s), raspy quack.
frustrated1 transposed down 5 semitones (470 -> 345 Hz), harsher: 34 Hz buzz at full depth, more crackle.
Port of reprimand3: the flute's 'tsk tsk' rhythm as quacks with the same note timing, pitches (290-540 Hz) and levels, raspy voice.
reprimand3 rhythm transposed down 7 semitones (190-360 Hz) so the scolding sits in the duck's register.
reprimand3 rhythm with every note replaced by a short hard bark (<= 120 ms, click on the attack), down 5 semitones: the most 'angry duck' of the three.
